Site display face; SOFT/WONK axes driven deliberately in globals.css for a hand-made-clothing brand

Deliberate brand match: these two client-facing documents wear the Daysi Collection site's own faces, declared in src/app/globals.css. Scoped to the two files, so the rule still fires everywhere else. It has to be a wildcard rather than a named face: the finding for the Google Fonts <link> carries its text only in `snippet`, from which no value is extractable, so a value-specific entry can never match it.
